organization.description: Athlos Oy is a Finnish X-ray imaging technology company specialising in direct conversion CdTe-CMOS and Si-CMOS sensors for dental, medical, and industrial applications.

service.name: X-Ray Detector Manufacturing Services
service.description: Precision X-ray detector manufacturing including CMOS bumping, flip chip bonding, wire bonding, die bonding, and full sensor characterization. Access to VTT Micronova cleanroom facility.

q1.question: What manufacturing services does Athlos offer?
q1.answer: Athlos provides precision X-ray detector manufacturing services including CMOS bumping, flip chip bonding, wire bonding, die bonding, and full sensor characterization.

q2.question: Does Athlos have cleanroom manufacturing access?
q2.answer: Yes. Athlos has access to the VTT Micronova nanofabrication facility in Espoo, Finland — one of Europe's leading cleanroom environments for semiconductor and detector manufacturing.

q3.question: Is Athlos ISO certified for manufacturing?
q3.answer: Yes. Athlos is ISO 13485:2016 certified, ensuring consistent quality management for medical device component manufacturing.
